propositions: CI workflow files from TRUSTED MAIN execute, causing CLI --timeout=300 --timeout-method=thread flags to permanently shadow any per-test-budget changes in pyproject.toml ini carried by a patchset
pytest-timeout precedence (CLI > env > ini) prevents a patchset-local ini timeout change from being exercised by its own Verified gate run

Removing --timeout and --timeout-method flags from _build-and-test.yml shared-tier lanes and single-sourcing the budget to [tool.pytest.ini_options] allows patchset ini changes to be tested by their own CI run
The effective hang budget remains unchanged (300 s, thread method) — only the authority moves from CLI flags to ini config
The conftest-floor hardening approach was rejected because pytest-timeout resolves config._env_timeout at session start read-only with no supported hook point
